description: This source file defines the 'Ceiling' class within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library, providing implementations for ceiling-related functions such as CEILING, CEILING.MATH, and CEILING.PRECISE, used for rounding numbers up to specified significance levels.

classes.name: Ceiling
classes.description: Provides static methods for ceiling-related rounding functions in spreadsheet calculations, including CEILING, CEILING.MATH, and CEILING.PRECISE.

methods.name: ceiling
methods.description: Implements the CEILING function, rounding a number up to the nearest multiple of significance, with array support.

methods.name: math
methods.description: Implements the CEILING.MATH function, rounding a number down to the nearest integer or multiple of significance, considering mode for negative numbers, with array support.

methods.name: precise
methods.description: Implements the CEILING.PRECISE function, rounding a number up, away from zero, to the nearest multiple of significance, with array support.

methods.name: ceilingMathTest
methods.description: Private helper to determine if ceiling math operation should use floor or ceil based on parameters.

methods.name: argumentsOk
methods.description: Validates arguments and computes the final rounded result or returns an error if invalid.

methods.name: floorCheck1Arg
methods.description: Checks for argument count compatibility with Excel and throws exception if not met.

search-terms: Rounding to significance in PHP spreadsheet
